def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    # The separator is the color on the full divider lines.
    sep = grid[sep_rows[0]][0] if sep_rows else grid[0][sep_cols[0]]
    r_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    blocks = [[ [grid[r][c] for c in range(c_bounds[j]+1, c_bounds[j+1])] for r in range(r_bounds[i]+1, r_bounds[i+1]) ] for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1) for j in []]
    # infer ordinary background as most frequent non-divider color; unusual cells are anomalies
    from collections import Counter
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != sep]
    bg = Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(r_bounds)-1):
        line=[]
        for j in range(len(c_bounds)-1):
            cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r_bounds[i]+1, r_bounds[i+1]) for c in range(c_bounds[j]+1, c_bounds[j+1])]
            anomalies=sum(v != bg for v in cells)
            line.append(1 if anomalies == 2 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out

# Validate demo
